hud.reiatsu_test.translation.byakuya.ban: Vibrant Display of a Thousand Cherry Blossoms
book.reiatsu_test.book_sode_no_shirayuki:
Zanpakuto of ice and snow. Forms: sealed, drawn, shikai, bankai.

Draw / sheathe: %1$s
Shikai: %2$s
Bankai: %3$s
Seal: %4$s

Abilities spend reiatsu. Say the phrase aloud or press the key.

Draw the sword first, then say:

Mae, Sode no Shirayuki
(舞え、袖白雪)

Key: %1$s
Cost: %2$s reiatsu

Shikai. A ring of ice and a pillar of light around you: damages and slows.

Say: Some no mai, Tsukishiro (初の舞・月白)
Key: %1$s
Cost: %2$s, cooldown: %3$s s

Shikai. A wave of ice runs forward and chills everything it touches.

Say: Tsugi no mai, Hakuren (次の舞・白漣)
Key: %1$s
Cost: %2$s, cooldown: %3$s s

Shikai. A blade of ice strikes along your line of sight. It is aimed when the cast ends, not when you press the key.

Say: San no mai, Shirafune (参の舞・白刀)
Key: %1$s
Cost: %2$s, cooldown: %3$s s

Needs shikai and 80 Rage (paid on entry). Lasts %2$s s, then falls back to shikai.

Say: Bankai, Hakka no Togame (卍解 白霞罸)
Key: %1$s

Bankai. A wall of ice grows where you look (up to 10 blocks): 9 blocks wide, 5 high, 2 thick. It stands for 10 s. Nobody walks through it and abilities stop at it, yours too, but every hit wears it down: after 60 damage it breaks. Rises from the bottom up, and only fills empty cells (nobody is walled in).

Say: Ice wall (氷の壁)
Key: %1$s
Cost: %2$s, cooldown: %3$s s

Bankai passive, nothing to cast. The land around where the bankai was released freezes and stays frozen until it ends. Every enemy (hostile mobs and, where player damage is on, other players) standing on it is slowed (Slowness I) and loses one heart every 3 s, whatever armor it wears. It ends the moment the bankai ends.

Drawn, shikai or bankai: the sword returns to its sealed form.

Say: Seal (封印)
Key: %1$s
book.reiatsu_test.book_senbonzakura.page: Senbonzakura

Zanpakuto of a thousand petal blades. Forms: sealed, drawn, shikai, bankai.

Draw / sheathe: %1$s
Shikai: %2$s
Bankai: %3$s
Seal: %4$s

Abilities spend reiatsu. Say the phrase aloud or press the key.
Shikai release

Draw the sword first, then say:

Chire, Senbonzakura
(散れ、千本桜)

Key: %1$s
Cost: %2$s reiatsu
Attack mode

Shikai. The petal swarm follows your aim and cuts everything on its way.

Say: Attack mode (攻撃モード)
Key: %1$s
Cost: %2$s, cooldown: %3$s s
Barrier mode

Shikai. The petals form a dome around you that soaks up damage and pushes everybody who comes close away from you (no damage).

Say: Barrier mode (防御モード)
Key: %1$s
Cost: %2$s, cooldown: %3$s s
Petal cage

Shikai. Aim at an enemy or a spot (range 22). After 0.6 s a sphere of petals (radius 5) pulses 6 times, 0.5 s apart; every pulse hurts everyone inside and renews Slowness III. A ring on the ground shows the area.

Say: Petal cage (散れの檻)
Key: %1$s
Cost: %2$s, cooldown: %3$s s
Bankai release

Needs shikai and 80 Rage (paid on entry). Lasts %2$s s, then falls back to shikai.

Say: Bankai, Senbonzakura Kageyoshi (卍解 千本桜景厳)
Key: %1$s
Scatter

Bankai. The giant blades fall apart into a storm of petals.

Say: Chire (散れ) or Petal storm (桜吹雪)
Key: %1$s
Cost: %2$s, cooldown: %3$s s
Hakuteiken

Bankai. The final strike: a white blade along your aim.

Say: Shukei: Hakuteiken (終景・白帝剣)
Key: %1$s
Cost: %2$s, cooldown: %3$s s
Senkei

Reserved. This bankai ability is in the phrase list but switched off in this version.

Say: Senkei (殲景)
Key: %1$s
Seal

Drawn, shikai or bankai: the sword returns to its sealed form.

Say: Seal (封印)
Key: %1$s
book.reiatsu_test.book_kido.page.1.title: Kido
book.reiatsu_test.book_kido.page.1:
Kido works in every state, with any sword or with empty hands. No release needed. Not while blocking.

Byakurai: %1$s
Shakkaho: %2$s
Sai: %3$s

Say the spell name or press the key.
book.reiatsu_test.book_kido.page.2.title: Hado 4: Byakurai
book.reiatsu_test.book_kido.page.2:
A white lightning beam, hits the first target in line. Range %4$s blocks, %5$s hp.

Say: Hado no yon, Byakurai (破道の四 白雷). Byakurai alone works too.
Key: %1$s
Cost: %2$s, cooldown: %3$s s
book.reiatsu_test.book_kido.page.3.title: Hado 31: Shakkaho
book.reiatsu_test.book_kido.page.3:
A red fireball flies to the first target and bursts: damage, fire, no block damage. Range %4$s blocks, %5$s hp in the centre.

Say: Hado no sanjuichi, Shakkaho (破道の三十一 赤火砲)
Key: %1$s
Cost: %2$s, cooldown: %3$s s
book.reiatsu_test.book_kido.page.4.title: Bakudo 1: Sai
book.reiatsu_test.book_kido.page.4:
A binding: the first target within %4$s blocks cannot move for a few seconds. No damage.

Say: Bakudo no ichi, Sai (縛道の一 塞)
Key: %1$s
Cost: %2$s, cooldown: %3$s s
